info.title: HubSpot Settings API
info.description: HubSpot Settings API — merged from the vendor's per-API OpenAPI documents.

post.summary: Add a new currency with central exchange rates.
post.description: Create a new currency with central exchange rates in the portal. Unsupported currencies cannot be added here.

get.summary: Retrieve information about the central exchange rates feature.
get.description: Retrieve details on whether the central exchange rates feature is enabled for the portal.

get.summary: Retrieve currencies not supported by central exchange rates.
get.description: Retrieve a list of currency codes that are not supported by the central exchange rates. Unsupported currencies will need to be manually updated.
Retrieve a list of all available currency codes and their names.
Get the details for the company currency. The company currency is used in deal totals, reports, and the default currency for new deals.

put.summary: Set or update the company currency.
put.description: Set or update the primary company currency.

get.description: Get a list of exchange rates

parameters.name: after

parameters.name: fromCurrencyCode
parameters.description: Filter results by the source currency code. Valid values include standard currency codes such as 'USD', 'EUR', etc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: toCurrencyCode
parameters.description: Filter results by the target currency code. Valid values include standard currency codes such as 'USD', 'EUR', etc.

post.description: Create a new exchange rate with specified conversion rate and currency codes.

get.description: Retrieve all current exchange rates for all currency pairs.

post.summary: Change the visibility of a specific currency pairs
post.description: Change the visibility setting for a currency pair. This will hide or display a currency pair for users in the HubSpot app.

get.summary: Get the details for a specific exchange rate
get.description: Retrieve the details for a specific exchange rate specified by its ID.

parameters.name: exchangeRateId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the exchange rate to retrieve.

patch.description: Update an existing conversion rate, specified by its ID.

parameters.name: exchangeRateId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the exchange rate to update.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all tax rates set up in the account tax rate library

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: A boolean to filter results by their active status.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

get.description: Retrieve a specific tax rate by its `taxRateGroupId`.

parameters.name: taxRateGroupId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tax rate group to retrieve.

get.description: Retrieve a list of teams from your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to paginate through the teams using the 'limit' and 'after' query parameters. It is useful for obtaining an overview of all teams configured in the account.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

post.description: Create a new team in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define the team's name, parent team, and members. The request body must include the team's name and members. Upon successful creation, the response will include the URL of the newly created team resource.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific team in your HubSpot account using the team's unique identifier. This endpoint is useful for accessing the team's properties, such as its name and parent team ID, to manage or display team-related data.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the team to retrieve.

delete.description: Delete a specific team from your HubSpot account using the team's unique identifier. This operation will remove the team and its associated data. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the team to delete.

patch.description: Update the details of a specific team in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the team's information, such as its name or parent team ID. Ensure that the teamId provided in the path is correct, as it identifies the team to be updated.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the team to update.

get.description: Retrieve a list of members for a specified team in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to paginate through the team members using the 'limit' and 'after' query parameters. It is useful for managing and viewing team compositions and roles within your organization.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the team whose members are being retrieved.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource, returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

post.description: Assign new members to a specific team in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to add users to a team by specifying their user IDs and roles. It is useful for managing team compositions and ensuring the right users have access to team resources.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the team to which members will be added.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Assign multiple members to a specific team in a single request. This endpoint allows for efficient management of team memberships by processing multiple assignments at once. It is useful for organizations looking to streamline their team management processes.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the team to which members will be assigned.

delete.description: Remove a specific member from a team in your HubSpot account. This operation requires specifying both the team and user identifiers. It is useful for managing team compositions by removing users who no longer need access or association with a particular team.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the team from which the member will be removed.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to be removed from the team.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of removal. Acceptable values are 'DEFAULT' or 'EXTRA'. Defaults to 'DEFAULT'.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to specify the maximum number of results per page and to use a paging cursor for navigating through the list of users.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

post.description: Create a new user in your HubSpot account using the specified details. This endpoint requires a JSON request body with user information such as email, first name, last name, role, and seats. A welcome email can be optionally sent to the new user.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.summary: Retrieves the roles on an account
get.description: Retrieve a list of user roles available in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides information about the different permission sets that can be assigned to users, which is useful for managing user access and permissions within the account.

get.summary: Retrieves the seats on this account
get.description: Retrieve the list of seats available in the account. This endpoint provides details about each seat, including its name, description, and the number of remaining seats. It is useful for managing and reviewing seat allocations within your organization.

get.summary: See details about this account's teams

get.description: Retrieves a user identified by `userId`. `userId` refers to the user's ID by default, or optionally email as specified by the `IdProperty` query param.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to retrieve.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: Specifies the property used to identify the user. Valid values are 'USER_ID' and 'EMAIL'.

put.description: Modifies a user identified by `userId`. `userId` refers to the user's ID by default, or optionally email as specified by the `IdProperty` query param.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to update.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: Specifies the property to use for identifying the user. Valid values are 'USER_ID' or 'EMAIL'.

delete.description: Removes a user identified by `userId`. `userId` refers to the user's ID by default, or optionally email as specified by the `IdProperty` query param.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to delete.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: Specifies the property to identify the user. Valid values are 'USER_ID' or 'EMAIL'.
